description: Show the results of an index check by its check_id: how many URLs are indexed, not found yet, or still being checked, and (optionally) the result for each URL. No credits are spent. Results per URL: indexed, not_found (Google does not show it yet; a free recheck may be pending), checking, rechecking, error (could not be checked; credits refunded).

include_urls.description: List the result for each URL (up to 500).

name: get_index_check
title: Get index check results
